scripts.title: Auto Play
scripts.author: tylenol
scripts.summary: Auto Player for Symphony Ochestra.
scripts.code:
if _G.__SYMPHONY_AP then
    local old = _G.__SYMPHONY_AP
    old.alive = false
    pcall(function() old.conn:Disconnect() end)
    pcall(function() old.win:Destroy() end)
    _G.__SYMPHONY_AP = nil
end

local Players = game:GetService('Players')
local RunService = game:GetService('RunService')
local LP = Players.LocalPlayer

local state = { alive = true, enabled = false, lastNote = {} }
_G.__SYMPHONY_AP = state

local function upsOf(f)
    local ok, ups = pcall(getupvalues, f)
    if not ok or type(ups) ~= 'table' then return nil end
    return ups
end

local engine, resolveErr = nil, nil
do
    local function isKeymap(t)
        for k in pairs(t) do
            return typeof(k) == 'EnumItem'
        end
        return false
    end

    local function validateLaneDown(f)
        if type(f) ~= 'function' then return nil end
        local ld = upsOf(f)
        if not ld or #ld < 13 then return nil end
        local Config = ld[8]
        if type(Config) ~= 'table' then return nil end
        if type(rawget(Config, 'PerfectWindow')) ~= 'number' then return nil end
        if type(rawget(Config, 'DefaultLaneKeys')) ~= 'table' then return nil end
        if type(ld[4]) ~= 'number' or type(ld[7]) ~= 'number' then return nil end
        if type(ld[10]) ~= 'table' or type(ld[2]) ~= 'table' then return nil end
        if type(ld[11]) ~= 'number' or type(ld[12]) ~= 'function' then return nil end
        return { laneDown = f, Config = Config, held = ld[2] }
    end

    local ok, res = pcall(function()
        local conns = getconnections(LP:GetAttributeChangedSignal('OrchestraPadKeys'))
        local found = nil
        for _, c in ipairs(conns) do
            if found then break end
            local u = upsOf(c.Function)
            if u and type(u[1]) == 'function' and type(u[2]) == 'boolean' and type(u[3]) == 'function' then
                local bl = upsOf(u[3])
                if bl then
                    for i = 1, #bl do
                        if found then break end
                        if type(bl[i]) == 'function' then
                            local ola = upsOf(bl[i])
                            if ola then
                                for j = 1, #ola do
                                    if found then break end
                                    if type(ola[j]) == 'function' then
                                        local hit = validateLaneDown(ola[j])
                                        if hit then
                                            local keymap
                                            for k = 1, #ola do
                                                if type(ola[k]) == 'table' and isKeymap(ola[k]) then
                                                    keymap = ola[k]
                                                end
                                            end
                                            if keymap then
                                                hit.onLaneAction = bl[i]
                                                hit.keymap = keymap
                                                found = hit
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        assert(found, 'RhythmClient lane engine not found')
        return found
    end)
    if ok then engine = res else resolveErr = tostring(res) end
end
state.engine = engine

local function pressLane(lane)
    local Config = engine.Config
    local keymap = engine.keymap
    local key = Config.LaneKeys and Config.LaneKeys[lane]
    if not (key and keymap[key] == lane) then
        key = nil
        for k, v in pairs(keymap) do
            if v == lane then key = k break end
        end
    end
    if not key then return false end
    return pcall(engine.onLaneAction, nil, Enum.UserInputState.Begin, { KeyCode = key })
end

if engine then
    state.conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not state.alive then return end
        if not state.enabled then return end

        local ld = upsOf(engine.laneDown)
        if not ld then return end
        local clockOff, songStart, notes = ld[4], ld[7], ld[10]
        if type(clockOff) ~= 'number' or type(songStart) ~= 'number' or type(notes) ~= 'table' then return end
        local n = #notes
        if n == 0 then return end

        local Config = engine.Config
        local audioOff = (Config.AudioOffset or 0) + (LP:GetAttribute('OrchestraAudioOffset') or 0) / 1000
        local pos = (os.clock() + clockOff) - songStart - audioOff

        local goodWindow = (type(ld[11]) == 'number' and ld[11]) or (Config.GoodWindow or 0.12)
        local horizon = goodWindow + (Config.LateGrace or 0.05) - 0.02

        for i = 1, n do
            local note = notes[i]
            if type(note) == 'table' and not note.Judged then
                local t = note.Time
                if type(t) == 'number' then
                    local dt = pos - t
                    if dt >= 0 and dt <= horizon then
                        local lane = note.Lane
                        if type(lane) == 'number' and lane >= 1 and lane <= 4 then
                            if pressLane(lane) then
                                state.lastNote[lane] = { t = t, len = tonumber(note.Length) or 0 }
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        for lane, info in pairs(state.lastNote) do
            if pos > info.t + info.len + 0.06 then
                engine.held[lane] = nil
                state.lastNote[lane] = nil
            end
        end
    end)
    print('[SymphonyAP] engine hooked: laneDown/onLaneAction/note-list online')
else
    warn('[SymphonyAP] engine hook FAILED: ' .. tostring(resolveErr))
end

local function setEnabled(v)
    state.enabled = v
    if not v then state.lastNote = {} end
end

local function fallbackGui()
    local gui = Instance.new('ScreenGui')
    gui.Name = 'SymphonyAutoplay'
    gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    gui.Parent = LP:WaitForChild('PlayerGui')
    local btn = Instance.new('TextButton')
    btn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 40)
    btn.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -75, 0, 8)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 48)
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    btn.TextSize = 16
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    btn.Text = 'Autoplay: OFF'
    btn.Parent = gui
    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        setEnabled(not state.enabled)
        btn.Text = 'Autoplay: ' .. (state.enabled and 'ON' or 'OFF')
        btn.BackgroundColor3 = state.enabled and Color3.fromRGB(46, 160, 84) or Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 48)
    end)
    state.win = { Destroy = function() gui:Destroy() end }
    print('[SymphonyAP] WindUI unavailable, using fallback toggle')
end

local windOk = pcall(function()
    local WindUI = loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Footagesus/WindUI/main/dist/main.lua'))()
    assert(typeof(WindUI) == 'table' and WindUI.CreateWindow, 'WindUI load failed')

    local Window = WindUI:CreateWindow({
        Title = 'Symphony Autoplay',
        Icon = 'music-note-bold-duotone',
        Folder = 'SymphonyAutoplay',
        OpenButton = { Enabled = true, Title = 'Symphony Autoplay' },
    })
    state.win = Window

    local Tab = Window:Tab({ Title = 'Autoplay', Icon = 'music-note-bold-duotone' })
    Tab:Toggle({
        Title = 'Autoplay Notes',
        Desc = 'Hits every note perfectly - holds included. Start any song and watch it play itself.',
        Default = false,
        Callback = function(v)
            setEnabled(v)
            WindUI:Notify({
                Title = 'Symphony Autoplay',
                Content = v and 'Enabled - start or keep playing a song.' or 'Disabled.',
                Icon = 'music-note-bold-duotone',
                Duration = 3,
            })
        end,
    })

    WindUI:Notify({
        Title = 'Symphony Autoplay',
        Content = engine and 'Engine hooked - ready to play.' or ('Hook failed: ' .. tostring(resolveErr)),
        Icon = 'music-note-bold-duotone',
        Duration = 5,
    })
    print('[SymphonyAP] WindUI ready')
end)

if not windOk then fallbackGui() end

scripts.title: SIMPLE SLAPPLE FARM
scripts.author: CRIMS0N_SCRIPTZX
scripts.summary: A simple and lightweight Slapple autofarm script for Slap Battles. Instead of teleporting your character around the map, this script brings all spawned Slapples directly to you. Need to click the execute button everytime u server hop.
scripts.code:
--[[
    SLAPPLE TELEPORTER + SERVER HOPPER
    NO UI - INSTANT EXECUTION - ALL 0.1s
]]

-- Services
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

-- Find Slapples Folder
local function findSlapplesFolder()
    local folder = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Slapples")
    if folder then return folder end
    
    for _, v in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if v:IsA("Folder") and v.Name:lower() == "slapples" then
            return v
        end
    end
    return nil
end

-- Teleport Slapples
local function teleportSlapples()
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not character then return 0 end
    
    local hrp = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hrp then return 0 end
    
    local teleported = 0
    local slapplesFolder = findSlapplesFolder()
    
    if slapplesFolder then
        for _, slapple in ipairs(slapplesFolder:GetChildren()) do
            pcall(function()
                if slapple:IsA("Model") then
                    local primaryPart = slapple.PrimaryPart or slapple:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or slapple:FindFirstChild("Part") or slapple:FindFirstChildOfClass("MeshPart")
                    if primaryPart then
                        primaryPart.CFrame = hrp.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
                        for _, part in ipairs(slapple:GetDescendants()) do
                            if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                                part.CFrame = hrp.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
                            end
                        end
                        teleported = teleported + 1
                    end
                elseif slapple:IsA("BasePart") then
                    slapple.CFrame = hrp.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
                    teleported = teleported + 1
                elseif slapple:IsA("MeshPart") then
                    slapple.CFrame = hrp.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
                    teleported = teleported + 1
                end
            end)
        end
    else
        for _, v in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if v:IsA("Model") or v:IsA("BasePart") or v:IsA("MeshPart") then
                local name = v.Name:lower()
                if string.find(name, "slapple") or string.find(name, "apple") then
                    pcall(function()
                        if v:IsA("Model") then
                            local primaryPart = v.PrimaryPart or v:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or v:FindFirstChild("Part")
                            if primaryPart then
                                primaryPart.CFrame = hrp.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
                                teleported = teleported + 1
                            end
                        else
                            v.CFrame = hrp.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
                            teleported = teleported + 1
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    return teleported
end

-- Click Go To Portal Button
local function clickGoToPortal()
    pcall(function()
        for _, v in ipairs(LocalPlayer.PlayerGui:GetDescendants()) do
            if v:IsA("TextButton") or v:IsA("ImageButton") then
                local text = ""
                if v:IsA("TextButton") then
                    text = v.Text:lower()
                end
                
                if string.find(text, "go to portal") or string.find(text, "goto portal") or string.find(text, "portal") or string.find(text, "enter") then
                    v:Click()
                end
                
                for _, child in ipairs(v:GetChildren()) do
                    if child:IsA("TextLabel") then
                        local childText = child.Text:lower()
                        if string.find(childText, "go to portal") or string.find(childText, "portal") or string.find(childText, "enter") then
                            v:Click()
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end

-- Server Hop
local function serverHop()
    pcall(function()
        local placeId = game.PlaceId
        local servers = {}
        
        pcall(function()
            local url = "https://games.roblox.com/v1/games/" .. placeId .. "/servers/Public?limit=100"
            local response = HttpService:GetAsync(url)
            local data = HttpService:JSONDecode(response)
            
            for _, server in ipairs(data.data) do
                if server.playing < server.maxPlayers then
                    table.insert(servers, server.id)
                end
            end
        end)
        
        if #servers > 0 then
            local randomServer = servers[math.random(1, #servers)]
            if randomServer ~= game.JobId then
                TeleportService:TeleportToPlaceInstance(placeId, randomServer, LocalPlayer)
            else
                if #servers > 1 then
                    local randomServer2 = servers[math.random(1, #servers)]
                    if randomServer2 ~= game.JobId then
                        TeleportService:TeleportToPlaceInstance(placeId, randomServer2, LocalPlayer)
                    end
                end
            end
        else
            TeleportService:Teleport(placeId, LocalPlayer)
        end
    end)
end

-- INSTANT EXECUTION - ALL 0.1s
print("🚀 Starting Slapple System...")

-- Wait for character
task.wait(1)

-- Initial run
local count = teleportSlapples()
print("✅ Initial teleport: " .. count .. " slapples")
clickGoToPortal()
print("✅ Clicked Go To Portal")

-- ALL LOOPS AT 0.1 SECONDS
-- Teleport Loop (0.1s)
task.spawn(function()
    while task.wait(0.1) do
        pcall(function()
            teleportSlapples()
        end)
    end
end)

-- Portal Click Loop (0.1s)
task.spawn(function()
    while task.wait(0.1) do
        pcall(function()
            clickGoToPortal()
        end)
    end
end)

-- Server Hop Loop (0.1s)
task.spawn(function()
    while task.wait(0.1) do
        pcall(function()
            serverHop()
        end)
    end
end)

print("✅ ALL SYSTEMS ACTIVE AT 0.1s")
print("🍎 Auto TP Slapples: 0.1s")
print("🟢 Auto Click Go To Portal: 0.1s")
print("🌐 Auto Server Hop: 0.1s")

local footstepId = "rbxassetid://9083849830"
local footstepSound = nil
local connectionMove = nil
local connectionSpeed = nil

-- KONFIGURASI KECEPATAN
local MIN_WALKSPEED = 6.6
local MAX_WALKSPEED = 25

-- KONFIGURASI AUDIO
local MIN_PLAYBACK = 0.785
local MAX_PLAYBACK = 0.767

local function setupFootsteps(char)
	if not char then return end
	local hrp = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
	local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
	if not hrp or not hum then return end

	if connectionMove then connectionMove:Disconnect() end
	if connectionSpeed then connectionSpeed:Disconnect() end
	if footstepSound then footstepSound:Destroy() end

	footstepSound = Instance.new("Sound")
	footstepSound.Name = "CustomFootstepSound"
	footstepSound.SoundId = footstepId
	footstepSound.Volume = 2.6
	footstepSound.Looped = true
	footstepSound.Parent = hrp

	local function updatePlaybackSpeed()
		local currentSpeed = hum.WalkSpeed
		local t = (currentSpeed - MIN_WALKSPEED) / (MAX_WALKSPEED - MIN_WALKSPEED)
		local targetPlayback = MIN_PLAYBACK + (MAX_PLAYBACK - MIN_PLAYBACK) * math.clamp(t, 0, 1)
		footstepSound.PlaybackSpeed = targetPlayback
	end

	connectionSpeed = hum:GetPropertyChangedSignal("WalkSpeed"):Connect(updatePlaybackSpeed)

	connectionMove = hum:GetPropertyChangedSignal("MoveDirection"):Connect(function()
		if hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0 and hum.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air then
			updatePlaybackSpeed()
			if not footstepSound.IsPlaying then
				footstepSound:Play()
			end
		else
			if footstepSound.IsPlaying then
				footstepSound:Stop()
			end
		end
	end)

	hum.StateChanged:Connect(function(_, newState)
		if newState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping or newState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall then
			if footstepSound.IsPlaying then
				footstepSound:Stop()
			end
		end
	end)
end

if lp.Character then
	task.spawn(setupFootsteps, lp.Character)
end

lp.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(newChar)
	task.spawn(setupFootsteps, newChar)
end)

local function stop_s(a)
	for _, t in ipairs(a:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
		if t ~= headTrackRef and t ~= ca and t ~= faceTrackRef then
			t:Stop(0.25)
		end
	end
end

local function stop_a()
	if ca then
		ca:Stop(0.25)
		ca = nil
	end
end

local function load(a, id)
	local anim = ins("Animation")
	anim.AnimationId = id
	return a:LoadAnimation(anim)
end

local function updateFaceAnimation(isEmoting, a)
	if not a then return end
	if isEmoting then
		if faceTrackRef and faceTrackRef.Animation.AnimationId == FACE_IDLE_ID then
			faceTrackRef:AdjustWeight(0)
			faceTrackRef = nil
		end
		if not faceTrackRef or faceTrackRef.Animation.AnimationId ~= FACE_EMOTE_ID then
			local faceAnim = ins("Animation")
			faceAnim.AnimationId = FACE_EMOTE_ID
			faceTrackRef = a:LoadAnimation(faceAnim)
			faceTrackRef.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4
			faceTrackRef.Looped = true
			faceTrackRef:Play(0.25)
		end
	else
		if faceTrackRef and faceTrackRef.Animation.AnimationId == FACE_EMOTE_ID then
			faceTrackRef:AdjustWeight(0)
			faceTrackRef = nil
		end
		if not faceTrackRef or faceTrackRef.Animation.AnimationId ~= FACE_IDLE_ID then
			local faceAnim = ins("Animation")
			faceAnim.AnimationId = FACE_IDLE_ID
			faceTrackRef = a:LoadAnimation(faceAnim)
			faceTrackRef.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4
			faceTrackRef.Looped = true
			faceTrackRef:Play(0.25)
		end
	end
end

local function upd(c, h, a)
	if not active or not c or not h or not a then return end
	if ca and ca.IsPlaying then return end

	local rp = c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not rp then return end

	local v = v3(rp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.X, 0, rp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Z)
	local m = v.Magnitude > 0.5
	local s = "idle"
	if m then s = ir and "run" or "walk" end

	for k, t in pairs(st) do
		if k ~= s and t and t.IsPlaying then t:Stop(0.25) end
	end

	if s == "idle" then
		if not st.idle or not st.idle.IsPlaying then
			stop_s(a)
			st.idle = load(a, I_ID)
			st.idle.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Idle
			st.idle:Play(0.25)
		end
		h.WalkSpeed = 16
	elseif s == "walk" then
		if not st.walk or not st.walk.IsPlaying then
			stop_s(a)
			st.walk = load(a, W_ID)
			st.walk.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement
			st.walk:Play(0.1)
		end
		st.walk:AdjustSpeed(1)
		h.WalkSpeed = 6.6
	elseif s == "run" then
		if not st.run or not st.run.IsPlaying then
			stop_s(a)
			st.run = load(a, R_ID)
			st.run.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement
			st.run:Play(0.25)
			st.run:AdjustSpeed(1.5)
		end
		h.WalkSpeed = 25
	end
end

local function playEmote(id)
	local c = lp.Character
	local h = c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local a = h and h:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
	if not a then return end
	ef.Visible = false
	stop_a()
	stop_s(a)
	local t = load(a, id)
	ca = t
	t.Looped = true
	t.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action3
	isConga = (id == C_ID)
	if isConga then
		h.WalkSpeed = 8
	else
		h.WalkSpeed = 0
	end
	t:Play(0.25)
	stopE.Visible = true
	updateFaceAnimation(true, a)
	task.spawn(function()
		while ca == t and t.IsPlaying do
			stop_s(a)
			task.wait(0.1)
		end
	end)
end

local function punch()
	local c = lp.Character
	local h = c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local rp = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local a = h and h:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
	if not a or not rp or not h then return end
	if stopE.Visible then return end

	-- CEK COOLDOWN
	local cooldownObj = h:FindFirstChild("PunchCooldown")
	if cooldownObj and os.clock() - cooldownObj.Value < 2 then return end

	if not cooldownObj then
		cooldownObj = Instance.new("NumberValue")
		cooldownObj.Name = "PunchCooldown"
		cooldownObj.Parent = h
	end
	cooldownObj.Value = os.clock()

	-- === PLAY SLASH SOUND (AWAL PUKULAN) ===
	local slash = Instance.new("Sound", rp)
	slash.SoundId = "rbxassetid://9067237166"
	slash.Volume = 2
	slash:Play()
	game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(slash, 2)

	isConga = false

	local t = load(a, P_ID)
	ca = t

	t.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action2
	if t.Length == 0 then t:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Length"):Wait() end
	t:Play(0.1, 1, 1)
	t:AdjustSpeed(1)
	updateFaceAnimation(true, a)

	-- =======================================================
	-- HITBOX DYNAMIC
	-- =======================================================
	task.spawn(function()
		local totalSpams = 15
		local totalDuration = 0.45
		local interval = totalDuration / totalSpams
		local hitSoundPlayed = false

		local hitTargets = {}

		for i = 1, totalSpams do
			if not rp then break end
			local box = Instance.new("Part")
			box.Size = Vector3.new(4.5, 6, 7.5)
			box.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
			box.CanCollide, box.CastShadow, box.Anchored = false, false, true
			box.CFrame = rp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -2)
			box.Parent = workspace
			game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(box, 0.4)

			local parts = workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(box.CFrame, box.Size)
			local isTouching = false

			for _, p in ipairs(parts) do
				local m = p.Parent
				local enemyHum = m and m:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

				if enemyHum and enemyHum.Health > 0 and m ~= c then
					isTouching = true

					local isTargetAPlayer = game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayerFromCharacter(m)

					if not isTargetAPlayer then
						if not hitTargets[m] then
							hitTargets[m] = true
							enemyHum:TakeDamage(5000)
						end
					end

					if not hitSoundPlayed then
						hitSoundPlayed = true
						local hitS = Instance.new("Sound", rp)
						hitS.SoundId = "rbxassetid://935843979"
						hitS.Volume = 2
						hitS:Play()
						game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(hitS, 1)
					end
					break
				end
			end

			if isTouching then
				box.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
			else
				box.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
			end
			task.wait(interval)
		end
	end)

	-- RESET STATE
	task.wait(t.Length / 1.7)
	if ca == t then
		ca = nil
		updateFaceAnimation(false, a)
	end
end

local function block()
	if stopE.Visible then return end
	local c = lp.Character
	local h = c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local rp = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local a = h and h:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
	if not a then return end
	isConga = false
	stop_a()
	stop_s(a)

	local t = load(a, B_ID)
	ca = t
	t.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action2
	if t.Length == 0 then t:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Length"):Wait() end
	h.WalkSpeed = 10.5
	t:Play(0.1)
	t:AdjustSpeed(0.8)
	updateFaceAnimation(true, a)
	task.wait((t.Length * 0.3) / 3)
	t:AdjustSpeed(0.5)
	t.Stopped:Wait()
	task.wait(0.3)

	-- dash hit Like slasher
	if rp and h and h.Health > 0 then
		task.spawn(function()
			local startSlash = Instance.new("Sound")
			startSlash.SoundId = "rbxassetid://9067237166"
			startSlash.Volume = 2
			startSlash.Parent = rp
			startSlash:Play()
			game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(startSlash, 2)
		end)

		local dashFinished = false
		task.spawn(function()
			local attach = Instance.new("Attachment")
			attach.Name = "DashAttachment"
			attach.Parent = rp

			local lv = Instance.new("LinearVelocity")
			lv.Name = "DashVelocity"
			lv.VectorVelocity = rp.CFrame.LookVector * 55
			lv.MaxForce = 999999
			lv.Attachment0 = attach
			lv.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
			lv.Parent = rp

			local totalDashSpams = 15
			local dashDuration = 0.22
			local interval = dashDuration / totalDashSpams
			for i = 1, totalDashSpams do
				if not rp or h.Health <= 0 then break end
				local box = Instance.new("Part")
				box.Size = Vector3.new(4.5, 6, 7.5)
				box.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
				box.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
				box.CanCollide = false
				box.CastShadow = false
				box.Anchored = true
				box.CFrame = rp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -2)
				box.Parent = workspace
				game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(box, 0.3)
				task.wait(interval)
			end
			if lv then lv:Destroy() end
			if attach then attach:Destroy() end
			dashFinished = true
		end)
		repeat task.wait() until dashFinished
	end

	-- combo after punch
	if h and h.Health > 0 and a and rp then
		stop_a()
		stop_s(a)

		local punchTrack = load(a, P_ID)
		ca = punchTrack
		punchTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action2
		if punchTrack.Length == 0 then punchTrack:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Length"):Wait() end
		punchTrack:Play(0.25)
		punchTrack:AdjustSpeed(2.4)
		updateFaceAnimation(true, a)

		task.spawn(function()
			local totalSpams = 11
			local totalDuration = 0.45
			local interval = totalDuration / totalSpams
			local hitSoundPlayed = false
			local hasHitTarget = false

			for i = 1, totalSpams do
				if not rp then break end
				local box = Instance.new("Part")
				box.Size = Vector3.new(4.5, 6, 7.5)
				box.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
				box.CanCollide = false
				box.CastShadow = false
				box.Anchored = true
				box.CFrame = rp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -2)
				box.Parent = workspace
				game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(box, 0.4)

				local parts = workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(box.CFrame, box.Size)
				local currentlyTouching = false

				for _, p in ipairs(parts) do
					local m = p.Parent
					local enemyHum = m and m:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

					if enemyHum and enemyHum.Health > 0 and m ~= c then
						currentlyTouching = true
						hasHitTarget = true

						if not hitSoundPlayed then
							hitSoundPlayed = true
							pcall(function()
								local hitSound = Instance.new("Sound")
								hitSound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://935843979"
								hitSound.Volume = 2
								hitSound.Parent = rp
								hitSound:Play()
								game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(hitSound, 1.5)
							end)
						end
						break
					end
				end

				if currentlyTouching or hasHitTarget then
					box.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
				else
					box.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
				end
				task.wait(interval)
			end
		end)

		task.wait(punchTrack.Length / 2.4)
		punchTrack:Stop(0.0)
		task.wait(0.8)
		if ca == punchTrack then
			ca = nil
			h.WalkSpeed = ir and 28 or 16
			updateFaceAnimation(false, a)
		end
	else
		if ca == t then
			ca = nil
			h.WalkSpeed = ir and 26 or 16
			updateFaceAnimation(false, a)
		end
	end
end

	smooth = 6,
	pred = .4,
	base = .1,
	dead = .05,
	side = 25,
	sideSmooth = 5
}

local function init(newCharacter)
	chr = newCharacter
	hum = chr:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
	hrp = chr:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

end

rs.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
	if not (chr and hrp and hum and getgenv().tilt) then return end

	local mv = hum.MoveDirection
	local sx, sp = 0, 0

	if mv.Magnitude > 0 then
		local rel = hrp.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(mv)
		sx = -rel.X * cfg.side

		local pos, vel = hrp.Position, hrp.Velocity
		local fut = pos + vel * cfg.ptime
		local dy = fut.Y - pos.Y

		if math.abs(dy) > cfg.dead then
			local dist = (Vector3.new(fut.X, pos.Y, fut.Z) - pos).Magnitude
			sp += math.atan2(dy, dist) * cfg.pred
		end

		sp += rel.Z * cfg.base
	end

	py += (sx - py) * math.min(dt * cfg.sideSmooth, 1)
	px += (sp - px) * math.clamp(dt * cfg.smooth, 0, 1)

	local yaw = CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(hrp.Orientation.Y), 0)
	hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(hrp.Position) * yaw * CFrame.Angles(px, 0, math.rad(py))
end)

--==================================================

local function removeESP(player)

	local data = espObjects[player]

	if not data then
		return
	end

	if data.objects then

		for _, obj in ipairs(data.objects) do

			if obj then
				pcall(function()
					obj:Destroy()
				end)
			end

		end

	end

	espObjects[player] = nil
end

--==================================================
-- CREATE ATTACHMENT
--==================================================

local function makeAttachment(part, name, objects)

	if not part then
		return nil
	end

	local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
	attachment.Name = name
	attachment.Parent = part

	table.insert(objects, attachment)

	return attachment
end

--==================================================
-- SKELETON BONE
--==================================================

local function makeBone(part0, part1, objects)

	if not part0 or not part1 then
		return
	end

	local a0 = makeAttachment(
		part0,
		"YOGA_SkeletonA",
		objects
	)

	local a1 = makeAttachment(
		part1,
		"YOGA_SkeletonB",
		objects
	)

	if not a0 or not a1 then
		return
	end

	local beam = Instance.new("Beam")

	beam.Name = "YOGA_Skeleton"

	beam.Attachment0 = a0
	beam.Attachment1 = a1

	beam.Width0 = 0.04
	beam.Width1 = 0.04

	beam.FaceCamera = true
	beam.LightEmission = 1
	beam.Segments = 1

	beam.Parent = part0

	table.insert(objects, beam)
end

--==================================================
-- CREATE ESP
--==================================================

local function createESP(player)

	if player == LocalPlayer then
		return
	end

	if not ESP_ENABLED then
		return
	end

	local character = player.Character

	if not character then
		return
	end

	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")

	if not humanoid or not root or not head then
		return
	end

	-- Jangan pernah numpuk ESP
	removeESP(player)

	local objects = {}

	--================================================
	-- BOX
	--================================================

	local box

	if BOX_ENABLED then

		box = Instance.new("Highlight")

		box.Name = "YOGA_Box"

		box.Adornee = character

		box.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop

		box.FillTransparency = 0.92
		box.OutlineTransparency = 0

		box.Parent = character

		table.insert(objects, box)

	end

	--================================================
	-- NAME
	--================================================

	local nameLabel

	if NAME_ENABLED then

		local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")

		billboard.Name = "YOGA_Name"

		billboard.Adornee = head

		billboard.Size = UDim2.new(0, 160, 0, 25)

		billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)

		billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true

		billboard.Parent = head

		table.insert(objects, billboard)

		nameLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")

		nameLabel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)

		nameLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1

		nameLabel.Text = player.DisplayName

		nameLabel.TextScaled = true

		nameLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold

		nameLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.25

		nameLabel.Parent = billboard

		table.insert(objects, nameLabel)

	end

	--================================================
	-- SKELETON
	--================================================

	if SKELETON_ENABLED then

		-- R15
		local upperTorso = character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
		local lowerTorso = character:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso")

		if upperTorso then

			makeBone(
				head,
				upperTorso,
				objects
			)

			local leftUpperArm =
				character:FindFirstChild("LeftUpperArm")

			local leftLowerArm =
				character:FindFirstChild("LeftLowerArm")

			local leftHand =
				character:FindFirstChild("LeftHand")

			local rightUpperArm =
				character:FindFirstChild("RightUpperArm")

			local rightLowerArm =
				character:FindFirstChild("RightLowerArm")

			local rightHand =
				character:FindFirstChild("RightHand")

			local leftUpperLeg =
				character:FindFirstChild("LeftUpperLeg")

			local leftLowerLeg =
				character:FindFirstChild("LeftLowerLeg")

			local leftFoot =
				character:FindFirstChild("LeftFoot")

			local rightUpperLeg =
				character:FindFirstChild("RightUpperLeg")

			local rightLowerLeg =
				character:FindFirstChild("RightLowerLeg")

			local rightFoot =
				character:FindFirstChild("RightFoot")

			if leftUpperArm then
				makeBone(
					upperTorso,
					leftUpperArm,
					objects
				)
			end

			if leftLowerArm then
				makeBone(
					leftUpperArm,
					leftLowerArm,
					objects
				)
			end

			if leftHand then
				makeBone(
					leftLowerArm,
					leftHand,
					objects
				)
			end

			if rightUpperArm then
				makeBone(
					upperTorso,
					rightUpperArm,
					objects
				)
			end

			if rightLowerArm then
				makeBone(
					rightUpperArm,
					rightLowerArm,
					objects
				)
			end

			if rightHand then
				makeBone(
					rightLowerArm,
					rightHand,
					objects
				)
			end

			if lowerTorso then

				makeBone(
					upperTorso,
					lowerTorso,
					objects
				)

				if leftUpperLeg then
					makeBone(
						lowerTorso,
						leftUpperLeg,
						objects
					)
				end

				if leftLowerLeg then
					makeBone(
						leftUpperLeg,
						leftLowerLeg,
						objects
					)

				if leftFoot then
					makeBone(
						leftLowerLeg,

						objects
					)

				if rightUpperLeg then
					makeBone(

					objects
				)

				local leftArm =
					character:FindFirstChild("Left Arm")

				local rightArm =
					character:FindFirstChild("Right Arm")

				local leftLeg =
					character:FindFirstChild("Left Leg")

				local rightLeg =
					character:FindFirstChild("Right Leg")

				if leftArm then
					makeBone(
						torso,
						leftArm,
						objects
					)
				end

						torso,

						objects
					)

--==================================================

local function createWhenReady(player)

	if not ESP_ENABLED then
		return
	end

	for i = 1, 30 do

		if not ESP_ENABLED then
			return
		end

		local character = player.Character

		if character then

			local humanoid =
				character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

			local root =
				character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

			local head =
				character:FindFirstChild("Head")

			if humanoid and root and head then

				-- Pastikan character masih character terbaru
				if player.Character == character then
					createESP(player)
				end

				return
			end

		end

		task.wait(0.2)

	end

end

--==================================================
-- SETUP PLAYER
--==================================================

local function setupPlayer(player)

	if player == LocalPlayer then
		return
	end

	-- Jangan pasang connection dua kali
	if playerConnections[player] then
		return
	end

	local connections = {}

	playerConnections[player] = connections

	--==============================================
	-- CHARACTER ADDED
	--==============================================

	table.insert(
		connections,
		player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)

			-- Bersihkan ESP karakter lama
			removeESP(player)

			-- Tunggu karakter benar-benar siap
			task.spawn(function()

				task.wait(0.15)

				-- Pastikan ini masih character terbaru
				if player.Character == character then
					createWhenReady(player)
				end

			end)

		end)
	)

	--==============================================
	-- CHARACTER REMOVING
	--==============================================

	table.insert(
		connections,
		player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function(character)

			local data = espObjects[player]

			if data and data.character == character then
				removeESP(player)
			end

		end)
	)

	--==============================================
	-- CHARACTER SEKARANG
	--==============================================

	if player.Character then

		task.spawn(function()
			createWhenReady(player)
		end)

	end

end

--==================================================
-- EXISTING PLAYERS
--==================================================

for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do

	setupPlayer(player)

end

--==================================================
-- NEW PLAYER
--==================================================

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)

	setupPlayer(player)

end)

--==================================================
-- PLAYER LEAVING
--==================================================

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)

	removeESP(player)

	if playerConnections[player] then

		for _, connection in ipairs(playerConnections[player]) do

			pcall(function()
				connection:Disconnect()
			end)

		end

	end

	playerConnections[player] = nil

end)

--==================================================
-- OPEN / CLOSE
--==================================================

toggle.Activated:Connect(function()

	ESP_ENABLED = not ESP_ENABLED

	if ESP_ENABLED then

		toggle.Text = "OPEN"

		-- Bersihkan semuanya dulu
		local players = {}

		for player in pairs(espObjects) do
			table.insert(players, player)
		end

		for _, player in ipairs(players) do
			removeESP(player)
		end

		-- Buat satu kali untuk semua player
		for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do

			if player ~= LocalPlayer then

				task.spawn(function()
					createWhenReady(player)
				end)

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()

	hue = (hue + 0.008) % 1

	local rainbow = Color3.fromHSV(
		hue,
		1,
		1
	)

	credit.TextColor3 = rainbow
	toggle.TextColor3 = rainbow

	-- Paksa ukuran tombol tetap
	toggle.Size = UDim2.new(0, 80, 0, 32)

	for player, data in pairs(espObjects) do

		--============================================
		-- Pastikan character masih valid
		--============================================

		if not player.Parent then

			removeESP(player)

		else

			local character = player.Character

			if not character or data.character ~= character then

				removeESP(player)

			else

				--====================================
				-- BOX
				--====================================

				if data.box then

					data.box.OutlineColor = rainbow
					data.box.FillColor = rainbow

				end

				--====================================
				-- NAME
				--====================================

				if data.label then

					data.label.TextColor3 = rainbow

				end

				--====================================
				-- SKELETON
				--====================================

				for _, object in ipairs(data.objects) do

					if object:IsA("Beam")
						and object.Name == "YOGA_Skeleton" then

						object.Color =
							ColorSequence.new(rainbow)

					end

				end

				--====================================
				-- TRACER
				--====================================

				if data.tracer then

					local root =
						character:FindFirstChild(
							"HumanoidRootPart"
						)

					local camera =
						workspace.CurrentCamera

					if root and camera then

						local position, visible =
							camera:WorldToViewportPoint(
								root.Position
							)

						if visible and position.Z > 0 then

							local startX =
								camera.ViewportSize.X / 2

							local startY =
								camera.ViewportSize.Y

							local endX =
								position.X

							local endY =
								position.Y

							local dx =
								endX - startX

							local dy =
								endY - startY

							local distance =
								math.sqrt(
									dx * dx +
									dy * dy
								)

							local angle =
								math.deg(
									math.atan2(
										dy,
										dx
									)
								) + 90

							data.tracer.Visible = true

							data.tracer.Position =
								UDim2.fromOffset(
									(startX + endX) / 2,
									(startY + endY) / 2
								)

							data.tracer.Size =
								UDim2.fromOffset(
									2,
									distance
								)

							data.tracer.Rotation = angle

							data.tracer.BackgroundColor3 =
								rainbow

						else

							data.tracer.Visible = false

						end

					else

						data.tracer.Visible = false

					end

				end

			end

		end

	end

end)

if pg:FindFirstChild("orch_bp_gui") then
	pg.orch_bp_gui:Destroy()
end

local keyMap = {
	["0"] = Enum.KeyCode.Zero, ["1"] = Enum.KeyCode.One, ["2"] = Enum.KeyCode.Two,
	["3"] = Enum.KeyCode.Three, ["4"] = Enum.KeyCode.Four, ["5"] = Enum.KeyCode.Five,
	["6"] = Enum.KeyCode.Six, ["7"] = Enum.KeyCode.Seven, ["8"] = Enum.KeyCode.Eight,
	["9"] = Enum.KeyCode.Nine, ["SPACE"] = Enum.KeyCode.Space, ["SPACEBAR"] = Enum.KeyCode.Space,
	[" "] = Enum.KeyCode.Space, ["LEFT"] = Enum.KeyCode.Left, ["ARROWLEFT"] = Enum.KeyCode.Left,
	["←"] = Enum.KeyCode.Left, ["RIGHT"] = Enum.KeyCode.Right, ["ARROWRIGHT"] = Enum.KeyCode.Right,
	["→"] = Enum.KeyCode.Right, ["UP"] = Enum.KeyCode.Up, ["ARROWUP"] = Enum.KeyCode.Up,
	["↑"] = Enum.KeyCode.Up, ["DOWN"] = Enum.KeyCode.Down, ["ARROWDOWN"] = Enum.KeyCode.Down,
	["↓"] = Enum.KeyCode.Down, [";"] = Enum.KeyCode.Semicolon, ["'"] = Enum.KeyCode.Quote,
	[","] = Enum.KeyCode.Comma, ["."] = Enum.KeyCode.Period, ["/"] = Enum.KeyCode.Slash,
	["\\"] = Enum.KeyCode.BackSlash, ["["] = Enum.KeyCode.LeftBracket, ["]"] = Enum.KeyCode.RightBracket,
	["-"] = Enum.KeyCode.Minus, ["="] = Enum.KeyCode.Equals, ["LSHIFT"] = Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift,
	["RSHIFT"] = Enum.KeyCode.RightShift, ["LCTRL"] = Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl, ["RCTRL"] = Enum.KeyCode.RightControl,
}

local enumList = Enum.KeyCode:GetEnumItems()

local function parseKey(txt)
	if type(txt) ~= "string" then return nil, "?" end
	local s = txt:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
	if s == "" then return nil, "?" end
	s = s:gsub("^Enum%.KeyCode%.", "")
	local br = s:match("^%[(.-)%]$")
	if br then s = br:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") end
	local up = s:upper()

	if keyMap[up] then return keyMap[up], s end

	local ok1, e1 = pcall(function() return Enum.KeyCode[s] end)
	if ok1 and typeof(e1) == "EnumItem" then return e1, s end

	local ok2, e2 = pcall(function() return Enum.KeyCode[up] end)
	if ok2 and typeof(e2) == "EnumItem" then return e2, up end

	for _, v in ipairs(enumList) do
		if v.Name:upper() == up then
			return v, v.Name
		end
	end
	return nil, s
end

local function grabKey(rec)
	local k = rec:FindFirstChild("Key")
	local raw
	if k then
		if k:IsA("TextLabel") or k:IsA("TextButton") or k:IsA("TextBox") then
			raw = k.Text
		elseif k:IsA("StringValue") then
			raw = k.Value
		elseif k:IsA("IntValue") or k:IsA("NumberValue") then
			raw = tostring(k.Value)
		end
	end
	if (not raw or raw == "") and rec:GetAttribute("Key") ~= nil then
		raw = tostring(rec:GetAttribute("Key"))
	end
	return parseKey(raw)
end

local hasFire = type(firesignal) == "function"
local hasConns = type(getconnections) == "function"

local function fireSig(sig, ...)
	if hasFire then
		pcall(firesignal, sig, ...)
	elseif hasConns then
		local ok, list = pcall(getconnections, sig)
		if ok and type(list) == "table" then
			for _, c in ipairs(list) do
				if c.Enabled ~= false then
					if type(c.Fire) == "function" then
						pcall(c.Fire, c, ...)
					elseif type(c.Function) == "function" then
						pcall(c.Function, ...)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

local function gotConns(sig)
	if not hasConns then return false end
	local ok, list = pcall(getconnections, sig)
	return ok and type(list) == "table" and #list > 0
end

local function midOf(b)
	local p, sz = b.AbsolutePosition, b.AbsoluteSize
	return p.X + sz.X * 0.5, p.Y + sz.Y * 0.5
end

local function pressBtn(b)
	local x, y = midOf(b)
	if not hasFire and not hasConns then
		pcall(function() VIM:SendMouseButtonEvent(x, y, 0, true, game, 1) end)
		return
	end
	local sent = false
	if gotConns(b.MouseButton1Down) then
		fireSig(b.MouseButton1Down, x, y)
		sent = true
	end
	if gotConns(b.InputBegan) then
		fireSig(b.InputBegan, {
			UserInputType = Enum.UserInputType.Touch,
			UserInputState = Enum.UserInputState.Begin,
			Position = Vector3.new(x, y, 0),
			Delta = Vector3.zero,
			KeyCode = Enum.KeyCode.Unknown,
		}, false)
		sent = true
	end
	if not sent then
		if gotConns(b.Activated) then
			fireSig(b.Activated, {
				UserInputType = Enum.UserInputType.Touch,
				UserInputState = Enum.UserInputState.Begin,
				Position = Vector3.new(x, y, 0),
			}, 1)
			sent = true
		elseif gotConns(b.MouseButton1Click) then
			fireSig(b.MouseButton1Click)
			sent = true
		elseif gotConns(b.TouchTap) then
			fireSig(b.TouchTap, { Vector2.new(x, y) })
			sent = true
		end
	end
	if not sent and hasFire then
		fireSig(b.MouseButton1Down, x, y)
	end
end

local function releaseBtn(b)
	local x, y = midOf(b)
	if not hasFire and not hasConns then
		pcall(function() VIM:SendMouseButtonEvent(x, y, 0, false, game, 1) end)
		return
	end
	local sent = false
	if gotConns(b.MouseButton1Up) then
		fireSig(b.MouseButton1Up, x, y)
		sent = true
	end
	if gotConns(b.InputEnded) then
		fireSig(b.InputEnded, {
			UserInputType = Enum.UserInputType.Touch,
			UserInputState = Enum.UserInputState.End,
			Position = Vector3.new(x, y, 0),
			Delta = Vector3.zero,
			KeyCode = Enum.KeyCode.Unknown,
		}, false)
		sent = true
	end
	if not sent and not hasConns and hasFire then
		fireSig(b.MouseButton1Up, x, y)
	end
end

local on = false
local mode = "Touch"
local off = 0
local hits = 0
local fc = 0

local seen = {}
local tailsHeld = {}
local notesHeld = {}
local relAt = {}
local down = {}

local function rel(idx)
	local d = down[idx]
	if not d then return end
	down[idx] = nil
	if d.m == "Key" and d.k then
		pcall(function() VIM:SendKeyEvent(false, d.k, false, game) end)
	elseif d.m == "Touch" and d.b and d.b.Parent then
		releaseBtn(d.b)
	end
end

local function press(info)
	local idx = info.idx
	if down[idx] then rel(idx) end
	if mode == "Touch" then
		if not info.btn then return false end
		down[idx] = { m = "Touch", b = info.btn }
		pressBtn(info.btn)
		return true
	else
		if not info.key then return false end
		down[idx] = { m = "Key", k = info.key }
		pcall(function() VIM:SendKeyEvent(true, info.key, false, game) end)
		return true
	end
end

local function clearAll()
	for i in pairs(down) do rel(i) end
	table.clear(tailsHeld)
	table.clear(notesHeld)
	table.clear(relAt)
	table.clear(seen)
end

	local rp, rs = rec.AbsolutePosition, rec.AbsoluteSize
	if gs.X <= 1 or gs.Y <= 1 or rs.X <= 1 or rs.Y <= 1 then return false, false end

	local cx = gp.X + gs.X * 0.5
	if cx < rp.X or cx > (rp.X + rs.X) then return false, false end

	local hit = (gp.Y + gs.Y >= rp.Y - off) and (gp.Y <= rp.Y + rs.Y)
	return hit, gs.Y > (rs.Y * 1.6)
end

local function findTail(note, rec, tails)
	local np, ns = note.AbsolutePosition, note.AbsoluteSize
	local nt, nb = np.Y, np.Y + ns.Y
	local rp, rs = rec.AbsolutePosition, rec.AbsoluteSize
	local rl, rr = rp.X, rp.X + rs.X

	local best, bestD = nil, math.huge
	for _, tl in ipairs(tails) do
		if tl.Visible then
			local tp, ts = tl.AbsolutePosition, tl.AbsoluteSize
			if ts.X > 1 and ts.Y > 1 then
				local tx = tp.X + ts.X * 0.5
				if tx >= rl and tx <= rr then
					local tt, tb = tp.Y, tp.Y + ts.Y
					if tb >= (nt - 40) and tt <= (nb + 40) then
						local d = math.abs(tb - nt)
						if d < bestD then
							bestD = d
							best = tl
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return best
end

local function getBtn(lane, rec)
	if lane:IsA("GuiButton") then return lane end
	if rec:IsA("GuiButton") then return rec end
	return lane:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("GuiButton") or rec:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("GuiButton")

local function scanLanes(hw)
	local out = {}
	for _, ch in ipairs(hw:GetChildren()) do

	return out
end

scripts.code:
local rs, plrs, ws = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"), game:GetService("Players"), game:GetService("Workspace")
local lp = plrs.LocalPlayer

local chukunhax = {
	silent = true,
	hitchance = 80,
	corner = 78,
	spread = 1.4,
	perfectcharge = true,
	tackleaim = true,
	stamina = true,
}

local function mod(...)
	local n = rs
	for _, v in ipairs({ ... }) do n = n and n:FindFirstChild(v) end
	local ok, m = pcall(require, n)
	return ok and m or nil
end

local proto = mod("Modules", "Actions", "ActionRemoteProtocol")
local cmds = mod("Modules", "Actions", "ActionCommands")
local sprint = mod("Modules", "Actions", "Sprint")
local teams = mod("Client", "Gameplay", "ActorTeams")
local match = mod("Modules", "Gameplay", "MatchSettings")

local function getroot(c)
	return c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

local function goals()
	local d = ws:FindFirstChild("Map") and ws.Map:FindFirstChild("Data")
	local a, b = d and d:FindFirstChild("Team1"), d and d:FindFirstChild("Team2")
	return a and a:FindFirstChild("Goal"), b and b:FindFirstChild("Goal")
end

local function enemygoal()
	local a, b = goals()
	if not (a and b) then return a or b end
	local ok, mine = pcall(teams.GetCharacterTeamName, lp.Character)
	local ok2, opp = ok and pcall(match.GetOpposingTeamName, mine)
	if ok2 and opp == "Team1" then return a end
	if ok2 and opp == "Team2" then return b end
	local r = getroot(lp.Character)
	if not r then return a end
	return (a.Position - r.Position).Magnitude > (b.Position - r.Position).Magnitude and a or b
end

local function keeper(goal)
	local best, dist = nil, 1e9
	for _, p in ipairs(plrs:GetPlayers()) do
		local r = p ~= lp and p.Team ~= lp.Team and getroot(p.Character)
		if r then
			local d = (r.Position - goal.Position).Magnitude
			if d < dist then best, dist = r, d end
		end
	end
	return best
end

local function spot(goal)
	local side = math.random() > 0.5 and 1 or -1
	local k = keeper(goal)
	if k then side = goal.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(k.Position).X > 0 and -1 or 1 end
	local x = side * goal.Size.X / 2 * (chukunhax.corner / 100)
	local y = goal.Size.Y / 2 * 0.8
	local jx = (math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * chukunhax.spread
	local jy = (math.random() - 0.5) * chukunhax.spread
	return (goal.CFrame * CFrame.new(x + jx, y + jy, 0)).Position
end

local function isshot(c)
	if c.Mode == "Volley" then return true end
	if cmds and typeof(cmds.IsVolley) == "function" then
		local ok, v = pcall(cmds.IsVolley, c)
		if ok and v then return true end
	end
	return c.PassType == "Shot"
end

local function closest()
	local me = getroot(lp.Character)
	local best, dist = nil, 25
	for _, p in ipairs(plrs:GetPlayers()) do
		local r = p ~= lp and p.Team ~= lp.Team and getroot(p.Character)
		if r and me then
			local d = (r.Position - me.Position).Magnitude
			if d < dist then best, dist = p, d end
		end
	end
	return best
end

local function aimat(c, pos)
	local aim = c.AimDirection
	local has = typeof(aim) == "table"
	local origin = has and aim.Origin
	if typeof(origin) ~= "Vector3" then
		local r = getroot(lp.Character)
		origin = r and r.Position
	end
	if not origin or (pos - origin).Magnitude < 0.1 then return end
	local dir = (pos - origin).Unit
	if has then
		aim.TargetPosition = pos
		aim.Direction = dir
	end
	c.TargetPosition = pos
	local flat = Vector3.new(dir.X, 0, dir.Z)
	if flat.Magnitude > 0 then c.KickDirection = flat.Unit end
end

local function edit(c)
	if chukunhax.perfectcharge and c.MaximumChargeSeconds then
		c.ChargeSeconds = c.MaximumChargeSeconds
	end
	if chukunhax.silent and isshot(c) and math.random(100) <= chukunhax.hitchance then
		local g = enemygoal()
		if g then aimat(c, spot(g)) end
	end
	if chukunhax.tackleaim and cmds and c.Kind == cmds.Kinds.Tackle and typeof(c.AimDirection) == "table" then
		local p = closest()
		local r = p and getroot(p.Character)
		if r then
			c.AimDirection.ClientHit = { Kind = "Player", UserId = p.UserId }
			c.TargetUserId = p.UserId
			aimat(c, r.Position)
		end
	end
end

for _, name in ipairs({ "Send", "Start", "Update", "Release" }) do
	local og = proto[name]
	if typeof(og) == "function" then
		proto[name] = function(c, ...)
			if typeof(c) == "table" then pcall(edit, c) end
			return og(c, ...)
		end
	end
end

if chukunhax.stamina and sprint and sprint.SetUnlimitedStamina then
	pcall(sprint.SetUnlimitedStamina, lp, "hax", true)
end

scripts.author: chukunhax
scripts.summary: voxel wars fps silent aim
scripts.code:
local Players, RS = game:GetService("Players"), game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local lp, cam = Players.LocalPlayer, workspace.CurrentCamera

local CFG = { fov = 160, hitChance = 85, headChance = 55, wallcheck = true, players = true, bots = true }

local FIRE = {}
for _, n in ipairs({ "FireRifle", "FireSMG", "FireLMG", "FirePistol", "FireDMR", "FireSniper", "FireShotgun" }) do
	local r = RS.Voxel.Remotes:FindFirstChild(n)
	if r then FIRE[r] = n end
end
local Ballistics = require(RS.Voxel.Ballistics)

local params = RaycastParams.new()
params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

local function alive(model)
	local hum = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	return hum and hum.Health > 0 and model:GetAttribute("Alive") ~= false
end

local function pick()
	local center, best, bestDist = cam.ViewportSize / 2, nil, CFG.fov
	local myTeam = tostring(lp.Team)
	local function consider(model)
		local root = model:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not root or not alive(model) then return end
		local p, on = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(root.Position)
		if not on then return end
		local d = (Vector2.new(p.X, p.Y) - center).Magnitude
		if d >= bestDist then return end
		if CFG.wallcheck then
			params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { lp.Character, model }
			if workspace:Raycast(cam.CFrame.Position, root.Position - cam.CFrame.Position, params) then return end
		end
		best, bestDist = model, d
	end
	if CFG.players then
		for _, pl in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if pl ~= lp and pl.Character and (pl.Team == nil or pl.Team ~= lp.Team) then consider(pl.Character) end
		end
	end
	local rigs = CFG.bots and workspace:FindFirstChild("BotRigs")
	if rigs then
		for _, m in ipairs(rigs:GetChildren()) do
			if m:GetAttribute("Team") ~= myTeam then consider(m) end
		end
	end
	return best
end

local function rewrite(name, a)
	local muzzle = a[1]
	if typeof(muzzle) ~= "Vector3" or typeof(a[2]) ~= "Vector3" then return end
	if math.random(100) > CFG.hitChance then return end
	local model = pick()
	if not model then return end
	local part = model:FindFirstChild(math.random(100) <= CFG.headChance and "Head" or "UpperTorso")
	if not part then return end

	local speed, arc = Ballistics.SPEED or 1700, nil
	if name == "FireSniper" then
		local tool = lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
		speed = Ballistics.RIFLE_SPEED * ((tool and tonumber(tool:GetAttribute("GsVelocity"))) or 1)
		arc = Ballistics.RIFLE_ARC
	end

	local point = part.Position + Vector3.new(math.random(-12, 12), math.random(-12, 12), math.random(-12, 12)) / 100
	local root = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if root and root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude > 0.5 then
		local dist = (point - muzzle).Magnitude
		local ok, t = pcall(Ballistics.flightTime, dist, speed, arc)
		point += root.AssemblyLinearVelocity * (ok and t or dist / speed)
	end

	local plain = (point - muzzle).Unit
	local aim = plain
	if name == "FireSniper" then
		local ok, v = pcall(Ballistics.launch, muzzle, point, speed, arc)
		if ok and typeof(v) == "Vector3" and v.Magnitude > 0.5 then aim = v.Unit end
	end

	if name == "FireShotgun" then
		for i = 3, #a do if typeof(a[i]) == "Vector3" then a[i] = plain end end
	else
		a[2] = aim
		if typeof(a[4]) == "Vector3" then a[4] = plain end
		if typeof(a[5]) == "number" then a[5] = 0 end
	end
end

local old
old = hookmetamethod(game, "__namecall", newcclosure(function(self, ...)
	local method = getnamecallmethod()
	local name = method == "FireServer" and FIRE[self]
	if name then
		local a, n = { ... }, select("#", ...)
		pcall(rewrite, name, a)
		setnamecallmethod(method)
		return old(self, table.unpack(a, 1, n))
	end
	return old(self, ...)
end))

-- Shows names and highlights through walls

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local enabled = true
local tracked = {}

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "PlayerESP"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local toggle = Instance.new("TextButton")
toggle.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 40)
toggle.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, 100)
toggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)
toggle.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
toggle.TextSize = 16
toggle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
toggle.Text = "ESP: ON"
toggle.Parent = gui

local function removeESP(player)
    if tracked[player] then
        for _, object in ipairs(tracked[player]) do
            object:Destroy()
        end
        tracked[player] = nil
    end
end

local function addESP(player, character)
    if player == LocalPlayer then return end

    removeESP(player)

    local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
    highlight.Name = "PlayerESPHighlight"
    highlight.Adornee = character
    highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
    highlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 80)
    highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    highlight.FillTransparency = 0.65
    highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
    highlight.Enabled = enabled
    highlight.Parent = character

    local head = character:WaitForChild("Head", 5)
    local label

    if head then
        local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
        billboard.Name = "PlayerESPName"
        billboard.Adornee = head
        billboard.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(160, 35)
        billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0)
        billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
        billboard.Enabled = enabled
        billboard.Parent = gui

        label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
        label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        label.Text = player.DisplayName .. " (@" .. player.Name .. ")"
        label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 80)
        label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
        label.TextScaled = true
        label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        label.Parent = billboard
    end

    tracked[player] = {highlight}
    if label and label.Parent then
        table.insert(tracked[player], label.Parent)
    end
end

local function setupPlayer(player)
    if player == LocalPlayer then return end

    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
        addESP(player, character)
    end)

    player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function()
        removeESP(player)
    end)

    if player.Character then
        addESP(player, player.Character)
    end
end

for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    setupPlayer(player)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(setupPlayer)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(removeESP)

toggle.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    enabled = not enabled
    toggle.Text = enabled and "ESP: ON" or "ESP: OFF"

    for _, objects in pairs(tracked) do
        for _, object in ipairs(objects) do
            if object:IsA("Highlight") or object:IsA("BillboardGui") then
                object.Enabled = enabled
            end
        end
    end
end)

--[[
========================================================
                       es2esp
                MADE BY XX PRODUCTIONS
========================================================
ROBLOX STUDIO - LOCAL SCRIPT
Place in StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts

VISUALS
- Body-fitted screen-space box ESP
- Glow ESP
- Skeleton ESP
- Player names
- Team names
- Distance
- Customizable ESP colors
- Adjustable max distance

CAMERA
- FOV setting: 60-120

INTERFACE
- Compact dark/purple GUI
- Mobile and PC support
- Draggable menu
- Floating open button
- GUI scale: 70%-120%
- Visuals and Config pages
- Avatar preview

CONFIG
- Save
- Load
- Search
- Delete
- Reset

PLAYER HANDLING
- Automatically detects new players
- Automatically handles respawns
- Automatically handles character changes
- Supports R6 and R15

NOTE:
Config presets are session-only. Persistent saving
requires a server-side DataStore implementation.
========================================================
]]

--======================================================
-- SERVICES
--======================================================

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local PlayerGui = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

--======================================================
-- CLEANUP
--======================================================

local oldGui = PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("es2esp")

if oldGui then
    oldGui:Destroy()
end

--======================================================
-- THEME
--======================================================

local Theme = {
    Background = Color3.fromRGB(31, 29, 40),
    Sidebar = Color3.fromRGB(25, 24, 33),
    Panel = Color3.fromRGB(49, 47, 61),
    Row = Color3.fromRGB(62, 59, 74),
    Accent = Color3.fromRGB(220, 105, 180),
    Text = Color3.fromRGB(245, 241, 249),
    Muted = Color3.fromRGB(165, 160, 180),
    Border = Color3.fromRGB(87, 82, 103),
    Blue = Color3.fromRGB(90, 185, 255),
    Green = Color3.fromRGB(90, 210, 150),
    Red = Color3.fromRGB(220, 85, 105),
}

--======================================================
-- CONFIG
--======================================================

local Config = {
    Enabled = true,

    Glow = true,
    Box = true,
    Skeleton = true,
    Names = true,
    TeamESP = true,
    Distance = true,

    ShowEnemies = true,
    ShowTeammates = true,

    MaxDistance = 25000,
    FOV = 90,
    GuiScale = 0.85,

    GlowTransparency = 0.35,
    BoxThickness = 2,
    SkeletonThickness = 2,

    Colors = {
        Glow = Color3.fromRGB(235, 105, 175),
        Box = Color3.fromRGB(235, 105, 175),
        Skeleton = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
        Names = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
        Team = Color3.fromRGB(90, 185, 255),
        Distance = Color3.fromRGB(190, 190, 205),
        Enemy = Color3.fromRGB(255, 105, 125),
        Teammate = Color3.fromRGB(90, 185, 255),
    }
}

local function DeepCopy(source)
    local result = {}

    for key, value in pairs(source) do
        if typeof(value) == "table" then
            result[key] = DeepCopy(value)
        else
            result[key] = value
        end
    end

    return result
end

local DefaultConfig = DeepCopy(Config)
local SavedConfigs = {}
local RefreshCallbacks = {}

--======================================================
-- COLOR PRESETS
--======================================================

local ColorPresets = {
    Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 170),
    Color3.fromRGB(190, 105, 255),
    Color3.fromRGB(75, 165, 255),
    Color3.fromRGB(65, 225, 225),
    Color3.fromRGB(80, 220, 145),
    Color3.fromRGB(255, 210, 80),
    Color3.fromRGB(255, 145, 75),
    Color3.fromRGB(255, 75, 90),
    Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
}

--======================================================
-- GUI HELPERS
--======================================================

local function New(className, parent, properties)
    local object = Instance.new(className)

    for key, value in pairs(properties or {}) do
        object[key] = value
    end

    object.Parent = parent
    return object
end

local function Round(object, radius)
    New("UICorner", object, {
        CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius or 8)
    })
end

local function Outline(object, color, thickness)
    return New("UIStroke", object, {
        Color = color or Theme.Border,
        Thickness = thickness or 1
    })
end

local function Text(parent, value, size, position, textSize, color)
    return New("TextLabel", parent, {
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Size = size,
        Position = position,
        Text = value,
        TextColor3 = color or Theme.Text,
        Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
        TextSize = textSize or 12,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
    })
end

local function Button(parent, value, size, position, color)
    local object = New("TextButton", parent, {
        Size = size,
        Position = position,
        BackgroundColor3 = color or Theme.Row,
        Text = value,
        TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
        Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
        TextSize = 11,
        AutoButtonColor = true,
        Active = true,
        Selectable = true
    })

    Round(object, 7)
    return object
end

--======================================================
-- SCREEN GUI
--======================================================

local Gui = New("ScreenGui", PlayerGui, {
    Name = "es2esp",
    ResetOnSpawn = false,
    IgnoreGuiInset = true,
    DisplayOrder = 50,
    ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
})

-- ESP overlays live directly under this frame.
local OverlayRoot = New("Frame", Gui, {
    Name = "ESP_Overlay",
    Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
    BorderSizePixel = 0,
    ZIndex = 2
})

--======================================================
-- MAIN WINDOW
--======================================================

local Main = New("Frame", Gui, {
    Name = "Main",
    AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
    Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(900, 570),
    BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background,
    BorderSizePixel = 0,
    Active = true,
    ZIndex = 10
})

Round(Main, 12)
Outline(Main, Theme.Border, 1.5)

local Scale = New("UIScale", Main, {
    Scale = Config.GuiScale
})

--======================================================
-- RESPONSIVE SCALE
--======================================================

local function ResizeWindow()
    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not camera then return end

    local viewport = camera.ViewportSize

    local fitScale = math.min(
        viewport.X / 920,
        viewport.Y / 600,
        1
    )

    Scale.Scale = math.min(
        Config.GuiScale,
        fitScale
    )
end

ResizeWindow()

if workspace.CurrentCamera then
    workspace.CurrentCamera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(
        ResizeWindow
    )
end

--======================================================
-- DRAG WINDOW
--======================================================

local dragging = false
local dragStart
local startPosition

local function StartDrag(input)
    if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        return
    end

    dragging = true
    dragStart = input.Position
    startPosition = Main.Position
end

local function StopDrag(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = false
    end
end

local function MoveDrag(input)
    if not dragging then return end

    if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
        and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        return
    end

    local delta = input.Position - dragStart

    Main.Position = UDim2.new(
        startPosition.X.Scale,
        startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,
        startPosition.Y.Scale,
        startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
    )
end

Main.InputBegan:Connect(StartDrag)
UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(StopDrag)
UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(MoveDrag)

--======================================================
-- SIDEBAR
--======================================================

local Sidebar = New("Frame", Main, {
    Size = UDim2.new(0, 175, 1, 0),
    BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Sidebar,
    BorderSizePixel = 0,
    ZIndex = 11
})

Round(Sidebar, 12)

Text(
    Sidebar,
    "es2esp",
    UDim2.fromOffset(145, 32),
    UDim2.fromOffset(20, 18),
    22
)

Text(
    Sidebar,
    "MADE BY XX PRODUCTIONS",
    UDim2.fromOffset(155, 20),
    UDim2.fromOffset(20, 49),
    9,
    Theme.Accent
)

Text(
    Sidebar,
    "FEATURES",
    UDim2.fromOffset(140, 20),
    UDim2.fromOffset(20, 100),
    9,
    Theme.Muted
)

local Nav = New("Frame", Sidebar, {
    Size = UDim2.new(1, -18, 0, 100),
    Position = UDim2.fromOffset(9, 127),
    BackgroundTransparency = 1
})

New("UIListLayout", Nav, {
    Padding = UDim.new(0, 6),
    SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
})

--======================================================
-- CONTENT
--======================================================

local Content = New("Frame", Main, {
    Size = UDim2.new(1, -195, 1, -25),
    Position = UDim2.fromOffset(185, 13),
    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
    ZIndex = 11
})

Text(
    Content,
    "Visuals",
    UDim2.fromOffset(350, 30),
    UDim2.fromOffset(10, 0),
    23
)

Text(
    Content,
    "Outlines, overlays and player colors",
    UDim2.fromOffset(400, 20),
    UDim2.fromOffset(10, 31),
    11,
    Theme.Muted
)

local Close = Button(
    Content,
    "×",
    UDim2.fromOffset(35, 30),
    UDim2.new(1, -43, 0, 0)
)

Close.TextSize = 19

--======================================================
-- PAGE SYSTEM
--======================================================

local Pages = {}
local NavButtons = {}

local function CreatePage(name)
    local page = New("Frame", Content, {
        Name = name,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -65),
        Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 65),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Visible = false
    })

    Pages[name] = page
    return page
end

local VisualPage = CreatePage("Visuals")
local ConfigPage = CreatePage("Config")

local function ShowPage(name)
    for pageName, page in pairs(Pages) do
        page.Visible = pageName == name
    end

    for pageName, button in pairs(NavButtons) do
        button.BackgroundColor3 =
            pageName == name and Theme.Row or Theme.Sidebar

        button.TextColor3 =
            pageName == name and Theme.Accent or Theme.Text
    end
end

local function AddNav(name, order)
    local button = Button(
        Nav,
        "   " .. name,
        UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 36),
        UDim2.new(),
        Theme.Sidebar
    )

    button.LayoutOrder = order
    button.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

    NavButtons[name] = button

    button.Activated:Connect(function()
        ShowPage(name)
    end)
end

AddNav("Visuals", 1)
AddNav("Config", 2)

--======================================================
-- CLOSE AND FLOATING BUTTON
--======================================================

Close.Activated:Connect(function()
    Main.Visible = false
end)

local Floating = Button(
    Gui,
    "ES",
    UDim2.fromOffset(54, 54),
    UDim2.new(1, -70, 0.55, 0),
    Theme.Sidebar
)

Floating.TextColor3 = Theme.Accent
Floating.TextSize = 17
Floating.ZIndex = 80

Round(Floating, 30)
Outline(Floating, Theme.Accent, 2)

Floating.Activated:Connect(function()
    Main.Visible = not Main.Visible
end)

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
    if processed then return end

    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightControl then
        Main.Visible = not Main.Visible
    end
end)

--======================================================
-- SCROLLING AND SETTINGS HELPERS
--======================================================

local function CreateScroll(parent, size, position)
    local scroll = New("ScrollingFrame", parent, {
        Size = size,
        Position = position,
        BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Panel,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        ScrollBarThickness = 4,

    })

    Round(scroll, 9)

    New("UIPadding", scroll, {
        PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 12),
        PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 12),
        PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 12),
        PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 12)
    })

    New("UIListLayout", scroll, {
        Padding = UDim.new(0, 7),
        SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
    })

    return scroll
end

local VisualSettings = CreateScroll(
    VisualPage,
    UDim2.new(0.57, -8, 1, 0),
    UDim2.new()
)

local PreviewPanel = New("Frame", VisualPage, {
    Size = UDim2.new(0.43, -5, 1, 0),
    Position = UDim2.new(0.57, 8, 0, 0),
    BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Panel,
    BorderSizePixel = 0
})

Round(PreviewPanel, 9)
Outline(PreviewPanel, Theme.Border, 1)

Text(
    PreviewPanel,
    "PREVIEW",
    UDim2.fromOffset(150, 24),
    UDim2.fromOffset(13, 8),
    10,
    Theme.Muted
)

local function Section(parent, name)
    local label = Text(
        parent,
        name,
        UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 25),
        UDim2.new(),
        10,
        Theme.Accent
    )

    label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    return label
end

local function SettingRow(parent, name)
    local row = New("Frame", parent, {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 43),
        BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Row,
        BorderSizePixel = 0
    })

    Round(row, 7)

    Text(
        row,
        name,
        UDim2.new(0.60, 0, 1, 0),
        UDim2.fromOffset(12, 0),
        11
    )

    return row
end

local function AddRefresh(callback)
    table.insert(RefreshCallbacks, callback)
end

local function AddToggle(name, key)
    local row = SettingRow(VisualSettings, name)

    local toggle = Button(
        row,
        "",
        UDim2.fromOffset(52, 25),
        UDim2.new(1, -63, 0.5, -12)
    )

    local function Refresh()
        toggle.Text = Config[key] and "ON" or "OFF"

        toggle.BackgroundColor3 = Config[key]
            and Theme.Accent
            or Color3.fromRGB(80, 76, 91)
    end

    toggle.Activated:Connect(function()
        Config[key] = not Config[key]
        Refresh()
    end)

    AddRefresh(Refresh)
    Refresh()
end

local function AddColor(name, key)
    local row = SettingRow(VisualSettings, name .. " color")

    local colorButton = Button(
        row,
        "CHANGE",
        UDim2.fromOffset(95, 27),
        UDim2.new(1, -107, 0.5, -13)
    )

    local index = 1

    local function Refresh()
        colorButton.BackgroundColor3 = Config.Colors[key]
    end

    colorButton.Activated:Connect(function()
        index = index % #ColorPresets + 1
        Config.Colors[key] = ColorPresets[index]
        Refresh()
    end)

    AddRefresh(Refresh)
    Refresh()
end

local function AddNumber(name, key, minimum, maximum)
    local row = SettingRow(VisualSettings, name)

    local input = New("TextBox", row, {
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(100, 27),
        Position = UDim2.new(1, -112, 0.5, -13),
        BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Sidebar,
        TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
        Text = tostring(Config[key]),
        ClearTextOnFocus = false,
        Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
        TextSize = 11
    })

    Round(input, 5)

    local function Refresh()
        input.Text = tostring(Config[key])
    end

    input.FocusLost:Connect(function()
        local value = tonumber(input.Text)

        if not value then
            Refresh()
            return
        end

        Config[key] = math.clamp(value, minimum, maximum)
        Refresh()
    end)

    AddRefresh(Refresh)
end

--======================================================
-- VISUAL SETTINGS
--======================================================

Section(VisualSettings, "GENERAL")

AddToggle("Enable ESP", "Enabled")
AddToggle("Glow ESP", "Glow")
AddToggle("Box ESP", "Box")
AddToggle("Skeleton ESP", "Skeleton")
AddToggle("Player names", "Names")
AddToggle("Team names", "TeamESP")
AddToggle("Distance", "Distance")
AddToggle("Show enemies", "ShowEnemies")
AddToggle("Show teammates", "ShowTeammates")

Section(VisualSettings, "CUSTOM COLORS")

AddColor("Glow", "Glow")
AddColor("Skeleton", "Skeleton")
AddColor("Box", "Box")
AddColor("Names", "Names")
AddColor("Team", "Team")
AddColor("Distance", "Distance")

Section(VisualSettings, "RANGE AND CAMERA")

AddNumber("Maximum distance (studs)", "MaxDistance", 100, 25000)
AddNumber("Field of view (60-120)", "FOV", 60, 120)

--======================================================
-- GUI SIZE
--======================================================

Section(VisualSettings, "INTERFACE")

local SizeRow = SettingRow(VisualSettings, "GUI size")

local SizeText = Text(
    SizeRow,
    "85%",
    UDim2.fromOffset(45, 27),
    UDim2.new(1, -145, 0.5, -13),
    11
)

local Minus = Button(
    SizeRow,
    "-",
    UDim2.fromOffset(28, 27),
    UDim2.new(1, -95, 0.5, -13)
)

local Plus = Button(
    SizeRow,
    "+",
    UDim2.fromOffset(28, 27),
    UDim2.new(1, -36, 0.5, -13)
)

local function SetScale(value)
    Config.GuiScale = math.clamp(value, 0.70, 1.20)

    ResizeWindow()

    SizeText.Text =
        tostring(math.floor(Config.GuiScale * 100)) .. "%"
end

Minus.Activated:Connect(function()
    SetScale(Config.GuiScale - 0.05)
end)

Plus.Activated:Connect(function()
    SetScale(Config.GuiScale + 0.05)
end)

--======================================================
-- AVATAR PREVIEW
--======================================================

local Viewport = New("ViewportFrame", PreviewPanel, {
    Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -65),
    Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 40),
    BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(62, 58, 77),
    BorderSizePixel = 0,
    Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(190, 185, 205),
    LightColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
    LightDirection = Vector3.new(-1, -1, -1)
})

Round(Viewport, 8)

local World = New("WorldModel", Viewport, {})

local PreviewCamera = New("Camera", Viewport, {})
Viewport.CurrentCamera = PreviewCamera

local function RefreshAvatar()
    World:ClearAllChildren()

    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not character then return end

    local wasArchivable = character.Archivable
    character.Archivable = true

    local success, clone = pcall(function()
        return character:Clone()
    end)

    character.Archivable = wasArchivable

    if not success or not clone then return end

    for _, object in ipairs(clone:GetDescendants()) do
        if object:IsA("Script")
            or object:IsA("LocalScript")
            or object:IsA("Tool") then
            object:Destroy()
        end
    end

    clone.Parent = World
    clone:PivotTo(CFrame.new())

    local _, size = clone:GetBoundingBox()
    local height = math.max(size.Y, 4)

    PreviewCamera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(
        Vector3.new(0, height * 0.45, height * 2.4),
        Vector3.new(0, height * 0.45, 0)
    )

    New("Highlight", clone, {
        Adornee = clone,
        FillColor = Config.Colors.Glow,
        OutlineColor = Config.Colors.Glow,
        FillTransparency = Config.GlowTransparency,
        DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
    })
end

task.spawn(function()
    task.wait(1)
    RefreshAvatar()
end)

LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    task.wait(1)
    RefreshAvatar()
end)

--======================================================
-- CONFIG PAGE
--======================================================

local ConfigScroll = CreateScroll(
    ConfigPage,
    UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
    UDim2.new()
)

Section(ConfigScroll, "CONFIG MANAGER")

local SaveRow = SettingRow(ConfigScroll, "Save current settings")

local SaveName = New("TextBox", SaveRow, {
    Size = UDim2.new(0.55, 0, 0, 27),
    Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 8),
    BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Sidebar,
    TextColor3 = Theme.Text,

local function ApplyConfig(saved)

        callback()

    RefreshAvatar()
